import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset from the CSV file
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv', names=['amount', 'is_fraud', 'transaction_type', 'hour_of_day'])

# Convert 'is_fraud' to categorical values for plotting
data['is_fraud'] = data['is_fraud'].astype('category').cat.rename_categories(['Not a Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Create a countplot to visualize the distribution of transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=data, hue='is_fraud')
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Types by Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset from the CSV file
data = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv', names=['amount', 'is_fraud', 'transaction_type', 'hour_of_day'])

# Convert 'is_fraud' to categorical values for plotting
data['is_fraud'] = data['is_fraud'].astype('category').cat.rename_categories(['Not a Fraud', 'Fraud'])

# Create a countplot to visualize the distribution of transaction types
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', data=data, hue='is_fraud')
plt.title('Distribution of Transaction Types by Fraud Status')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Fraud Status')
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
